brief:
A US taxpayer group has filed a complaint with the International Criminal Court seeking an investigation into President Trump and Secretary of State Marco Rubio for allegedly aiding genocide in Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. The group said it had exhausted all other legal avenues to pursue justice.

Seth Donnelly is listed as co-founder of the organization behind the petition.

title: US taxpayer group petitions ICC to investigate Trump, Rubio over Gaza
